scope: source-evidence, derived teacher, intervention, presentation, consumers, independent courts
reference_architecture: IRIS geometry/semantic/graphics, TESSA, AXIS, MIRA, Compiler.Graphics
policy: Every source is subject to exhaustive multi-domain review with evidence receipt and explicit UNKNOWN; never equate importer counters with original author physics.
Count mechanical data and stylized 2D data independently; do not reject whole record based solely on realistic source materials.
Every group is observable/derivable/consumer-dependent with independent court, provenance and head ownership.
Negative truth requires actual independent test or exhaustive annotation; do not infer from missing imported operators.
No semantic/drawable or morphology truth from object names, material names, disconnected islands or unsourced generated images.
Source truth, capability contract, representation policy and student input are distinct types.
Unseen protection applies to creator, rig lineage, geometry, cross-format, style and subject, not filename only.
Never train, materialize, or mint PASS from this catalog itself.
